name: cno_nitrogen_15_proton_capture
equation: 1 x n15 plus 1 x h1 gives 1 x c12 plus 1 x he4
names: nitrogen_15 plus proton gives carbon_12 helium_4

name: deuterium_tritium_fusion
equation: 1 x h2 plus 1 x h3 gives 1 x he4 plus 1 x n1
names: deuterium plus tritium gives helium_4 neutron
notes: also how the first minutes made helium

name: deuterium_deuterium_fusion
equation: 2 x h2 gives 1 x he3 plus 1 x n1
notes: one of two branches, about half each

name: deuterium_deuterium_fusion_tritium_branch
equation: 2 x h2 gives 1 x h3 plus 1 x h1
notes: one of two branches, about half each

name: deuterium_helium_3_fusion
equation: 1 x h2 plus 1 x he3 gives 1 x he4 plus 1 x h1
names: deuterium plus helium_3 gives helium_4 proton
notes: no neutron; also how the first minutes made helium

name: uranium_235_fission
equation: 1 x u235 plus 1 x n1 gives 1 x ba141 plus 1 x kr92 plus 3 x n1

name: uranium_235_fission_xenon_channel
equation: 1 x u235 plus 1 x n1 gives 1 x xe140 plus 1 x sr94 plus 2 x n1

name: plutonium_239_fission
equation: 1 x pu239 plus 1 x n1 gives 1 x xe134 plus 1 x zr103 plus 3 x n1

name: proton_neutron_capture
equation: 1 x h1 plus 1 x n1 gives 1 x h2 plus 1 x gamma
names: proton plus neutron gives deuterium gamma
notes: the first nuclei of the first minutes; also in the water of a reactor

name: carbon_14_formation
equation: 1 x n14 plus 1 x n1 gives 1 x c14 plus 1 x h1
names: nitrogen_14 plus neutron gives carbon_14 proton
notes: neutrons from cosmic rays; a proton leaves

name: uranium_238_neutron_capture
equation: 1 x u238 plus 1 x n1 gives 1 x u239 plus 1 x gamma
names: uranium_238 plus neutron gives uranium_239 gamma

name: neutron_beta_decay
equation: 1 x n1 gives 1 x h1 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: neutron gives proton electron antineutrino
notes: a free neutron lasts about fifteen minutes

name: carbon_14_decay
equation: 1 x c14 gives 1 x n14 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: carbon_14 gives nitrogen_14 electron antineutrino

name: tritium_decay
equation: 1 x h3 gives 1 x he3 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: tritium gives helium_3 electron antineutrino

name: potassium_40_decay
equation: 1 x k40 gives 1 x ca40 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: potassium_40 gives calcium_40 electron antineutrino
notes: main branch, about nine in ten; the rest is potassium_40_electron_capture

name: uranium_239_decay
equation: 1 x u239 gives 1 x np239 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: uranium_239 gives neptunium_239 electron antineutrino

name: neptunium_239_decay
equation: 1 x np239 gives 1 x pu239 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: neptunium_239 gives plutonium_239 electron antineutrino

name: cesium_137_decay
equation: 1 x cs137 gives 1 x ba137 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: cesium_137 gives barium_137 electron antineutrino

name: iodine_131_decay
equation: 1 x i131 gives 1 x xe131 plus 1 x e plus 1 x antineutrino
names: iodine_131 gives xenon_131 electron antineutrino

name: nitrogen_13_decay
equation: 1 x n13 gives 1 x c13 plus 1 x positron plus 1 x neutrino
names: nitrogen_13 gives carbon_13 positron neutrino
notes: beta plus, inside the cno cycle

name: oxygen_15_decay
equation: 1 x o15 gives 1 x n15 plus 1 x positron plus 1 x neutrino
names: oxygen_15 gives nitrogen_15 positron neutrino
notes: beta plus, inside the cno cycle

name: fluorine_18_decay
equation: 1 x f18 gives 1 x o18 plus 1 x positron plus 1 x neutrino
names: fluorine_18 gives oxygen_18 positron neutrino

name: potassium_40_electron_capture
equation: 1 x k40 plus 1 x e gives 1 x ar40 plus 1 x neutrino
names: potassium_40 plus electron gives argon_40 neutrino
notes: about one decay in ten; the argon dates rocks

name: beryllium_7_electron_capture
equation: 1 x be7 plus 1 x e gives 1 x li7 plus 1 x neutrino
names: beryllium_7 plus electron gives lithium_7 neutrino
notes: second branch of the proton proton chain

name: uranium_238_alpha_decay
equation: 1 x u238 gives 1 x th234 plus 1 x he4
names: uranium_238 gives thorium_234 helium_4

name: radium_226_alpha_decay
equation: 1 x ra226 gives 1 x rn222 plus 1 x he4
names: radium_226 gives radon_222 helium_4

name: radon_222_alpha_decay
equation: 1 x rn222 gives 1 x po218 plus 1 x he4
names: radon_222 gives polonium_218 helium_4

name: americium_241_alpha_decay
equation: 1 x am241 gives 1 x np237 plus 1 x he4
names: americium_241 gives neptunium_237 helium_4

name: plutonium_238_alpha_decay
equation: 1 x pu238 gives 1 x u234 plus 1 x he4
names: plutonium_238 gives uranium_234 helium_4
notes: heat source of deep space probes
